title: Identity bootstrap can run before its loader exists, permanently bypassing the sign-in gate
failing_substep: tests/browser/two-manager-browser-journey.cjs:115 signIn -> click SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE
steps: Run the unchanged Validate Gameplay Fast browser-journey command with CMS_CHROMIUM_MULTI_CONTEXT=1 and CMS_SHOWDOWN_LENGTH=3 on current main.
After both pages finish the loading presentation, click Start a Showdown (#newShowdown) as signIn() does.
Wait for the SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE button. In runs 1 and 2 Daniel times out; in run 3 Daniel signs in and selects his manager, then Nik times out.
expected: Both fresh signed-out browsers must open the identity gate and offer SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE. J1.1 passes only after both distinct accounts select their managers.
actual: All three official runs pass J0.1/J0.2 and fail J1.1 with locator.click: Timeout 30000ms exceeded, waiting for getByRole(button, name=SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE). The affected manager has already navigated to createShowdown, has an empty identity badge and no identity overlay. Both recorded page-error lists are empty.

differences_between_runs.observation: Affected manager is Daniel in runs 1/2 and Nik in run 3. Run 3 completes Daniel sign-in and manager choice before failing on Nik.
Untouched Nik remains on mainMenu with badge SIGN IN in run 1 and an empty badge in run 2. Daniel remains on mainMenu with badge DANIEL and an unpaired CONNECT PLAYERS panel when Nik fails in run 3.

root_cause: index.html loads deferred showdown.js before optionalModules.js and app.js. While a deferred script executes, document.readyState can already be interactive. initializeOnlinePlayerEntry() sets __cmsOnlinePlayerEntryBootstrap=true and then schedules start() with setTimeout(0) instead of waiting for DOMContentLoaded. The timer can execute before the later deferred scripts supply loadRuntimeScript and reportApplicationError. ensureOnlinePlayerIdentitySurface() then throws Online runtime loader unavailable; the catch calls an optional error reporter that is also absent and silently loses the error. The bootstrap flag remains true and there is no automatic retry. onlinePlayerIdentity.js never loads, so its capture-phase gameplay guard is absent and initializeScreens() routes #newShowdown directly to createShowdown. This explains both the blank badge and the empty page-error lists.

cause_evidence.scope: Additional startup diagnostics only; these are not extra invocations of the official journey and grant no journey-check passes. Fresh contexts, same unmodified main, test-only emulator switch, separate local server port 4194. Auth/Firestore emulators had stopped; no sign-in or gameplay writes were attempted.
cause_evidence.instrumentation: An addInitScript wrapper logs document.readyState, typeof window.loadRuntimeScript, typeof window.reportApplicationError and identity presence immediately before the original setTimeout callback containing "void start()". It forwards the original callback and delay unchanged.

fix.change: For the follow-up game-code owner: schedule identity startup after all deferred dependencies initialize, and keep failed initialization retryable. Install or await the identity gate before enabling gameplay-entry navigation. This audit applies no fix.

limitations: No official run reaches J1.2 or any pairing/gameplay/reload/terminal check.
